changes: Corrected the raw graph's duplicated actual-outcome flags by making the observed change an indicator and the bucket the sole actual outcome.
Dated synthesized stress-condition nodes to the end of the target period.
Downgraded all broad economy, recession, and tightening mechanisms to background_hypothesis.
Retained the historical STLFSI interpretation as context rather than a cause.
caveats: The mechanism sources discuss broad economic or market signals and do not directly identify drivers of the March STLFSI change.
The below-zero index-level interpretation is not equivalent to interpretation of a negative monthly change.
